applicableAreas: Trees proposed within 15-25 feet of overhead electric line (distribution zones)
findings.comment: Trees are positioned within prohibited clearance zones (0, 0.4, 0.9, and 6.2 feet from OHE line) without documented written approval from Austin Energy. The 15-foot minimum for non-utility-compatible trees and 25-foot minimum for large trees are clearly not met. No variance request, conditional use permit, or Austin Energy waiver is documented on the plans or in supplementary documents.

agentTrace.observation: Vision analysis measured trees at distances of 0, 0.4, 0.9, and 6.2 feet from the OHE line on southern boundary. Master comment report references Austin Energy design criteria and review sections (UCM § 1.10.10.3 & 4) but shows no documented approval for trees in restricted zones.
agentTrace.reasoning: The regulations are unambiguous: non-UC trees require 15 feet clearance, large trees require 25 feet clearance. Proposed trees are dramatically closer (within 1 foot in some cases). UCM § 1.10.10.4 specifically states variations to planting distances and utility-compatible species require explicit written approval from Austin Energy. No such approval is evident in the submitted plans or supplementary documents.
